patches.description: Return false from the virtual-input setting read
patches.rationale: The 4.42 settings read defaults to the enabled value 2 when the stored setting is missing, so this patch keeps the SendInput fallback selected after every config refresh.

patches.description: Store false in the runtime virtual-input setter
patches.rationale: The 4.42 runtime setter stores the incoming control-message byte to the manager flag at 0x1405a86f1; zeroing the movzbl keeps runtime control messages on the SendInput path.

landmarks: virtual mouse app config result=ignored reason=invalid_input_mode mode=

review.evidence: Disassembly review on 4.42.0.2770: virtual-input flag moved into virtual_mouse_switch_setting_manager; sole writers are the config read (cmp/sete/store, default enabled=2) at 0x5a78e2 and the runtime setter (movzbl dl -> store at 0x1405a86f1) at 0x5a7994; the 4.39.2 constructor-argument site no longer exists (masked search zero candidates, full-text disassembly confirms). USER32 SendInput and wevtapi imports unchanged.
